scope: Role query nano printf repair, build gate, targeted regression cases and concise design note

root_cause.explanation: Original role Format used PRIu64 despite actual nano libc not supporting 64-bit integer formats; current code renders uptime with the existing Decimal64 helper before snprintf.

verified: Timestamp remains an unquoted JSON number; protocol field names and schema are unchanged.
Decimal64 accepts the uint64_t input and uses a 21-byte output including NUL.
All added and modified C/C++ files in DELTA, including the new role header, are covered by the build format gate.
Format gate executes before IDF and rechecks against the actual saved build sdkconfig during artifact inspection.
Nine printf guard unit tests executed independently and passed.
An in-memory mutation restoring PRIu64 is rejected by the guard under actual nano configuration; fixed header has no wide-format findings.
Native wire regression cases cover ordinary uptime and protocol maximum 9007199254740991; source reviewed, execution belongs to the build owner.
The design note describes App-only repair, existing resource/NVS retention, rollback and the agreed next pipeline.
